# Projection definition

A projection: an extractor, an optional comparator and a renderer, with their configuration. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/definition/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/definition/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/definition/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`identifier`](#identifier) | Yes |  |
| `title` | string |  | At least 1 character. |
| `description` | string |  | At least 1 character. |
| `extractor` | string or object | Yes |  |
| `comparator` | [`comparatorFile`](#comparatorfile) or object or object |  | How changes are matched, explained and ordered. A string or an object with `file` names a custom comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml`); an object without `file` is the default comparator, with its options. Omitted, the default comparator with no options. |
| `renderer` | [`renderer`](#renderer) | Yes |  |

| `correspondence` | map of array of string |  |  |
| `execution` | object |  |  |

| `execution.environment` | array of string |  | Items are unique. |

Optional and enforced where reads are mediated; the default is the whole repository, or a nested project's own directory. At least 1 item. At most 100 items. |

No other properties are allowed.

## Definitions

### `identifier`

Type: string. Pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,99}$`.

### `path`

Relative to the definition's project (the directory holding its `.github/projections` or `.projections`); leading `../` segments leave a nested project.

Type: string. Pattern `^(?:\.\.(?:/\.\.)*|(?:\.\./)*(?!\.{1,2}(?:/|$))(?!.*/\.{1,2}(?:/|$))(?!.*//)(?!.*/$)(?!.*[\\\u0000-\u001f\u007f])[^/?#:][^?#:]*)$`. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters.

### `sources`

Type: array of [`path`](#path). At most 256 items. Items are unique.

### `defaultComparatorOptions`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order` | object |  |  |
| `order.by` | string | Yes | Pattern `^(?:dependents\|data\..+)$`. |
| `order.direction` | `"ascending"` or `"descending"` |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

### `upstream`

A built-in extractor, with its inputs, whose extraction of the same revision the command receives.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extractor` | [`identifier`](#identifier) | Yes |  |
| `inputs` | [`data`](extraction.md#data) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

### `comparatorFile`

A comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml` or `.comparator.yml`), relative to the definition's project: the custom comparator, run sandboxed over the default comparator.

Type: [`path`](#path) and string.

### `renderer`

Type: [`identifier`](#identifier) or object.

### `reproducibility`

Type: `"hermetic"` or `"pinned-toolchain"` or `"local"` or `"unknown"` or `"external"`.

### `determinism`

How reproducible the extraction is, like a test's, declared and never enforced: `pure`, a function of the revision's files (cached by tree, and a rerun must match); `environmental`, the files plus the toolchain and dependencies (cached only within one environment; the default for custom extractors); `observed`, live or varying data such as timings or coverage (never reused silently).

Type: `"pure"` or `"environmental"` or `"observed"`.

### `kindPresentation`

How viewers present one extraction kind.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `"danger"` or `"warning"` or `"success"` or `"info"` or `"neutral"` or `"blue"` or `"teal"` or `"pink"` or `"lime"` or `"purple"` or `"cyan"` or `"indigo"` or `"sky"` or `"orange"` or `"green"` or `"red"` or `"violet"` or `"emerald"` or `"rose"` or `"amber"` or `"citron"` |  | The color its items take where a renderer colors by kind: a meaning (`danger`, `warning`, `success`, `info`, `neutral`) or a categorical hue. Renderers paint it with theme tokens. |
| `noun` | object |  | The words for one item and for any other count, such as `{"singular": "hidden key", "plural": "hidden keys"}`. |
| `noun.singular` | string | Yes | Pattern `\S`. At least 1 character. At most 64 characters. |
| `noun.plural` | string | Yes | Pattern `\S`. At least 1 character. At most 64 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.

### `kinds`

How viewers present extraction kinds, keyed by kind: a color for renderers that color items by kind, and the summary bar's noun. A kind's key also names the flag of that name (`data.flags`) where a renderer draws flags.

Type: map of [`kindPresentation`](#kindpresentation). At most 64 properties.

### `presentation`

Initial host and renderer settings for viewers. Viewers can still change them.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `highlighting` | `"animated"` or `"on"` or `"off"` |  | Change highlighting: fading with the transition, always, or off. |
| `changesOnly` | boolean |  | Show only changed items. |
| `mode` | `"animated"` or `"side-by-side"` or `"swipe"` or `"diff"` |  | Initial comparison mode; hosts use it only when the renderer supports it. |
| `durationMs` | integer |  | Playback duration from before to after at 1× speed, in milliseconds. Omitted, it scales with the number of steps. At least 500. At most 120000. |
| `rendererOptions` | map of string or number or boolean |  | Initial values of the renderer's declared controls, keyed by control ID. Hosts ignore unknown IDs and invalid values, with a notice. At most 32 properties. |
| `kinds` | [`kinds`](#kinds) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.
